SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-18-2008 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RISKIN, SETH IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT NYGREN, DAVID JOSEPH DR. THE COURT NOTES THAT THE STATEMENTS MADE BY DEFENDANT CONCERNING PLAINTIFF'S DEMEANOR DURING THE SUBJECT TRAFFIC STOP ARE UNTRUE AND INACCURATE. HOWEVER, THE EVIDENCE PRESENTED WAS NOT SUFFICIENT TO ESTABLISH THE REQUISITE ELEMENT OF MAILCE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED OCT-01-2008 ORDERED DESTROYED
